desc: Building summary CSVs for main set
code:
labels={'gee_exch_unc':'GEE, uncorrected','gee_exch_md':'GEE, Mancl-DeRouen','gee_exch_fg':'GEE, Fay-Graubard',
 'gee_ar1_fg':'GEE AR(1), Fay-Graubard','glmer':'GLMM, Wald','mmm_cc':'MMM (with check)','flip':'Sign-flip test'}
main7=list(labels)
mechs=['GenBinaryY','GLMM-native','GLMM-AR1','Copula-AR1']
Nb=['N=10','N=15-25','N=35-65','N=75-145']; Tb=['T=2','T=3-4','T=6-10']
all19=main7+[s for s in sorted(d.strategy.unique()) if s not in main7]
def summ(g):
    a=g[g.n>=20]; na=len(a)
    return pd.Series({'n_points':len(g),'n_assessed':na,
      'mean_rate':a.rate.mean() if na else np.nan,
      'mean_abs_dep':(a.rate-5).abs().mean() if na else np.nan,
      'mean_mcse':a.mcse.mean() if na else np.nan,
      'max_rate':a.rate.max() if na else np.nan,
      'n_above':int(a.hi.sum()),'pct_above':100*a.hi.mean() if na else np.nan,
      'n_below':int(a.lo.sum()),'pct_below':100*a.lo.mean() if na else np.nan,
      'mean_pu':g.pu.mean(),'min_pu':g.pu.min(),'mean_upow':g.upow.mean()})
M=d[d.set=='main'].copy()
M['dgp']=pd.Categorical(M.dgp,mechs,ordered=True); M['Nband']=pd.Categorical(M.Nband,Nb,ordered=True)
M['Tband']=pd.Categorical(M.Tband,Tb,ordered=True); M['strategy']=pd.Categorical(M.strategy,all19,ordered=True)
reg=M.groupby(['dgp','Tband','Nband','strategy'],observed=True).apply(summ).reset_index()
reg.insert(4,'label',reg.strategy.map(labels).fillna(reg.strategy.astype(str)))
mech=M.groupby(['dgp','strategy'],observed=True).apply(summ).reset_index()
mech.insert(2,'label',mech.strategy.map(labels).fillna(mech.strategy.astype(str)))
r7=reg[reg.strategy.isin(main7)]; m7=mech[mech.strategy.isin(main7)]
for df,f in [(r7,'region_summary_main7.csv'),(m7,'mechanism_summary_main7.csv'),(mech,'mechanism_summary_all19.csv'),(reg,'region_summary_all19.csv')]:
    df.round(3).to_csv('mech/'+f,index=False)
print(len(r7),len(m7),len(mech))
pd.set_option('display.width',250)
print(m7[['dgp','strategy','n_assessed','mean_rate','n_above','pct_above','n_below','mean_pu','mean_upow']].round(1).to_string())

interval_all=[s for s in all19 if s not in ('flip','glmer_lrt')]
interval_main=[s for s in main7 if s!='flip']
reg['calibrated']=(reg.n_assessed>0)&(reg.n_above==0)&reg.mean_rate.between(2.5,7.5)
def lab(s): return labels.get(s,s)
rows=[]
for cset,cands in [('main6',interval_main),('all17',interval_all)]:
    for (m,t,n),g in reg[reg.strategy.isin(cands)].groupby(['dgp','Tband','Nband'],observed=True):
        c=g[g.calibrated].sort_values('mean_pu',ascending=False)
        if len(c)==0:
            rows.append(dict(candidate_set=cset,dgp=m,Tband=t,Nband=n,n_calibrated=0,best='none',best_label='none',best_pu=np.nan,best_rate=np.nan,best_upow=np.nan,equivalent='',equivalent_labels=''))

        rows.append(dict(candidate_set=cset,dgp=m,Tband=t,Nband=n,n_calibrated=len(c),best=b.strategy,best_label=lab(b.strategy),
            best_pu=b.mean_pu,best_rate=b.mean_rate,best_upow=b.mean_upow,
            equivalent=';'.join(eq.strategy.astype(str)),equivalent_labels='; '.join(eq.strategy.astype(str).map(lab))))

import matplotlib as mpl, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from matplotlib.colors import TwoSlopeNorm, Normalize
from matplotlib.patches import Rectangle
apply_figure_style(sizes=(7,6,6))
cols=[(t,n) for t in Tb for n in Nb]
nlab={'N=10':'10','N=15-25':'15–25','N=35-65':'35–65','N=75-145':'75–145'}
mtitle={'GenBinaryY':'GenBinaryY (latent + transition)','GLMM-native':'GLMM-native (random intercept)','GLMM-AR1':'GLMM-AR1 (random intercept + AR(1))','Copula-AR1':'Copula-AR1 (serial correlation only)'}
R7=reg[reg.strategy.isin(main7)].copy(); R7['strategy']=R7.strategy.astype(str)
def mat(m,var):
    g=R7[R7.dgp==m].set_index(['strategy','Tband','Nband'])
    return np.array([[g.loc[(s,t,n),var] for (t,n) in cols] for s in main7])
def lum(rgba): r,g_,b=rgba[:3]; return 0.2126*r+0.7152*g_+0.0722*b
def heat(var,fname,cmap,norm,fmt,cbar_label,outline=True):
    fig,axs=plt.subplots(2,2,figsize=(7,4.9),gridspec_kw=dict(hspace=0.42,wspace=0.04,left=0.17,right=0.985,top=0.9,bottom=0.12))
    for i,(ax,m) in enumerate(zip(axs.flat,mechs)):
        V=mat(m,var); A=mat(m,'n_above'); NA=mat(m,'n_assessed')
        Vc=np.clip(V,norm.vmin,norm.vmax)
        im=ax.imshow(np.ma.masked_invalid(Vc),cmap=cmap,norm=norm,aspect='auto')
        ax.set_facecolor('0.85')
        for r in range(V.shape[0]):
            for c in range(V.shape[1]):
                v=V[r,c]
                if np.isnan(v): ax.text(c,r,'–',ha='center',va='center',fontsize=6,color='0.3'); continue
                col=cmap(norm(np.clip(v,norm.vmin,norm.vmax)))
                ax.text(c,r,fmt(v),ha='center',va='center',fontsize=6,color='white' if lum(col)<0.45 else 'black',
                        fontweight='bold' if (outline and A[r,c]>0) else 'normal')
                if outline and A[r,c]>0:
                    ax.add_patch(Rectangle((c-0.5+0.04,r-0.5+0.04),0.92,0.92,fill=False,lw=1.3,ec='black'))
        for x in [3.5,7.5]: ax.axvline(x,color='white',lw=2.5)
        ax.set_xticks(range(12)); ax.set_xticklabels([nlab[n] for t,n in cols],rotation=90,fontsize=6)
        ax.set_yticks(range(7)); ax.set_yticklabels([labels[s] for s in main7] if i%2==0 else [],fontsize=6)
        ax.tick_params(length=0)
        for s in ax.spines.values(): s.set_visible(False)
        for j,t in enumerate(Tb):
            ax.text(1.5+4*j,-0.75,t,ha='center',va='bottom',fontsize=6)
        ax.set_title(mtitle[m],loc='left',fontsize=7,pad=11)
        if i>=2: ax.set_xlabel('Number of clusters N',fontsize=6,labelpad=2)
        panel_letter(ax,'abcd'[i])
    cax=fig.add_axes([0.35,0.035,0.45,0.018])
    cb=fig.colorbar(mpl.cm.ScalarMappable(norm=norm,cmap=cmap),cax=cax,orientation='horizontal')
    cb.set_label(cbar_label,fontsize=6); cb.ax.tick_params(labelsize=6)
    fig.savefig(f'mech/{fname}.pdf'); fig.savefig(f'mech/{fname}.png',dpi=300)
    return fig
cmapA=plt.get_cmap('RdBu_r')
normA=TwoSlopeNorm(vmin=0,vcenter=5,vmax=15)
figA=heat('mean_rate','figA_typeI_heatmap',cmapA,normA,lambda v:f'{v:.1f}','Mean type I error (%) over assessed design points; nominal 5% = white; clipped at 0 and 15. Boxed, bold: ≥1 point clearly above 7.5%')
cmapB=plt.get_cmap('viridis')
figB=heat('mean_pu','figB_usable_heatmap',cmapB,Normalize(0,100),lambda v:f'{v:.0f}','Usable share under H0 (%) — mean over design points',outline=False)
print('ok')

def heat(var,fname,cmap,norm,fmt,cbar_label,outline=True,ticks=None):
    fig,axs=plt.subplots(2,2,figsize=(7,5.4),gridspec_kw=dict(hspace=0.5,wspace=0.04,left=0.17,right=0.985,top=0.9,bottom=0.155))
    for i,(ax,m) in enumerate(zip(axs.flat,mechs)):
        V=mat(m,var); A=mat(m,'n_above')
        ax.imshow(np.ma.masked_invalid(np.clip(V,norm.vmin,norm.vmax)),cmap=cmap,norm=norm,aspect='auto')
        ax.set_facecolor('0.85')
        for r in range(V.shape[0]):
            for c in range(V.shape[1]):
                v=V[r,c]
                if np.isnan(v): ax.text(c,r,'n.a.',ha='center',va='center',fontsize=6,color='0.25'); continue
                col=cmap(norm(np.clip(v,norm.vmin,norm.vmax)))
                flag=outline and A[r,c]>0
                ax.text(c,r,fmt(v),ha='center',va='center',fontsize=6,color='white' if lum(col)<0.45 else 'black',fontweight='bold' if flag else 'normal')

cat > mech/results_note.md <<'EOF'
# Results by mechanism: key numbers (main set M1–M5, 480 design points per mechanism)

Definitions. A design point is *assessed* if it has ≥20 usable H0 replicates. "Above" means the exact 95% CI lower limit exceeds 7.5%. A strategy is *calibrated* in a mechanism × region cell when it has 0 points above and a mean type I error in [2.5, 7.5]%. Wald tests use a t reference with N−p df. The source table has no coverage, so coverage is not reported.

## 1. Which strategies fail where (points above 7.5% out of assessed points; GenBinaryY / GLMM-native / GLMM-AR1 / Copula-AR1)
- GEE, uncorrected: 91/480 (19.0%), 70 (14.6%), 76 (15.8%), 100 (20.8%). All four mechanisms fail at N ≤ 25.
- GLMM, Wald: 110/416 (26.4%), 42/416 (10.1%), 43/416 (10.3%), 223/414 (53.9%). This is the most mechanism-dependent strategy: it fails at large N under GenBinaryY and Copula-AR1 (mean 16.0% and 16.7% at T=2, N=75–145). Its usable share at T=2 is only 1–39%.
- GEE, Mancl-DeRouen: 14 (2.9%), 2 (0.4%), 1 (0.2%), 28 (5.8%). Failures concentrate at T ≥ 3 with N ≤ 25 under GenBinaryY and Copula-AR1.
- GEE, Fay-Graubard: 1, 1, 1, 8 (1.7%). GEE AR(1), Fay-Graubard: 0, 1, 1, 0.
- MMM (with check): 0 above under every mechanism, but conservative (mean 4.4 / 4.1 / 4.3 / 4.9%) and usable less often (mean pu 83.6 / 83.9 / 83.4 / 83.2%).
- Sign-flip test: 0 above under every mechanism (mean 5.5 / 5.5 / 5.4 / 5.4%) with the highest usable share (96.2 / 96.9 / 96.7 / 96.1%). It produces no interval.

## 2. Best strategy per mechanism × region (main-text interval strategies)
The nominal best (calibrated, highest usable share) differs across mechanisms in 6 of 12 regions. In 11 of 12 regions, however, at least one strategy is best or within 2.5 points of the best under all four mechanisms. The only exception is T=2, N=10. There, GLMM Wald is best under the two GLMM mechanisms (usable share 1.2% and 1.0%) and exchangeable GEE-FG is best under GenBinaryY and Copula-AR1 (7.3% and 7.6%). Mechanism dependence is therefore mainly about *which strategies fail*, not about which one wins. Considering all 17 interval strategies, the nominal best differs in 7 of 12 regions and a common best-or-equivalent strategy exists in all 12.

## 3. Robust choice when the mechanism is unknown (calibrated under all four)
- T=2, N=10: no robust interval strategy. The closest is GLMM Wald, calibrated under 3/4 mechanisms with a minimum usable share of 0.7%.
- T=2, N=15–25: GLMM Wald only (usable 6.5–8.5%).
- T=2, N ≥ 35: uncorrected GEE (usable 78.1–79.3% at N=35–65, mean type I error 2.6–3.1%; 98.3–98.5% at N=75–145).
- T=3–10, N ≤ 65: GEE AR(1), Fay-Graubard. Usable share is 36.7–44.8% (T=3–4, N=10), 70.5–78.8% (N=15–25), 97.3–98.6% (N=35–65), 82.0–88.2% (T=6–10, N=10), 96.9–98.5% (N=15–25) and 99.9–100% (N=35–65).
- T ≥ 3, N=75–145: every main-text GEE variant and MMM is robust (usable 97.4–100%).

GEE AR(1)-FG is robust in 9/12 regions and MMM in 8/12. The sign-flip test has 0 points above in every region, with a minimum usable share of 31.6% (T=2, N=10) and 65.8% (T=2, N=15–25). Among all 17 strategies, independence GEE with CR2 is robust at T=2, N ≤ 25 (usable 25.2% and 41.6%).

## 4. Sensitivity sets
The robust choices had 0 points above 7.5% in every M1c and M6–M7 cell. Where they lost "calibrated" status, they became conservative: in M1c the mean was below 2.5% on 1–3 points at T=3–4, N=10. The exception is GLMM Wald at T=2, N=15–25 under M6–M7, which was never usable (0 assessed points, pu 0%). That removes the only robust option in that region. GLMM Wald fails more under M6–M7 GenBinaryY (76/160 points above, 47.5%), and Mancl-DeRouen fails there on 18/192. GEE AR(1)-FG and MMM have 0 points above in both sensitivity sets. The conclusions of sections 2–3 stand, except that at T=2 with N ≤ 25 no interval method is robust once M6–M7 is included.
